raw.details:
Hack. Build. Innovate. Solve real-world problems.

Maya Devi University presents Algonex 1.0, an exciting hackathon where you turn ideas into working solutions.

Whether you are a seasoned developer, a UI/UX enthusiast, an AI explorer, a problem solver, or someone with a great idea, this is the opportunity to build something meaningful, collaborate with like-minded innovators, and showcase your skills.

What is Algonex 1.0?

Algonex is a hands-on innovation challenge designed to encourage students to identify real-world problems and develop creative, technology-driven solutions.

Participants will work in teams to ideate, design, develop, and present their solutions to a panel of judges.

From AI and Web Development to Blockchain, IoT, Cybersecurity, Mobile Applications, and emerging technologies, participants are encouraged to think beyond conventional solutions and build something impactful.

Why Participate?

  • Build a real project from idea to implementation
  • Put your coding, design, problem-solving and innovation skills to the test
  • Work with teammates from diverse technical backgrounds
  • Get an opportunity to showcase your project to industry/academic experts
  • Compete with talented students and innovators
  • Earn certificates, recognition and exciting prizes
  • Add a meaningful project to your resume and portfolio
  • Meet fellow developers, creators and future entrepreneurs

Registration Details

To participate in Algonex 1.0, participants are required to complete the registration process.

Registration Fee: ₹500 per team member

The registration fee includes:

  • Hackathon participation access
  • Certificate of Participation
  • Opportunity to showcase your project
  • Interaction with fellow innovators, mentors, and judges
  • Eligibility to compete for exciting prizes and recognition

Participants can register individually or as a team.
Each team member must complete the registration payment separately.

 

Who Can Participate?

The hackathon is open to students from all disciplines and departments.

You don’t need to be an expert programmer. If you have an idea, a willingness to learn, and the drive to build, you belong here.

Students interested in AI/ML, Web & App Development, Cybersecurity, Blockchain, IoT, Cloud, UI/UX, Data Science and other technology domains are encouraged to participate.

The Challenge

Identify. Ideate. Build. Pitch.

Participants will be given the opportunity to work on meaningful problem statements and develop innovative solutions using technology.

The focus isn’t just on writing code, it’s about solving problems.

Think differently. Build boldly. Create something that matters.

Event Highlights

Ideation → Development → Testing → Presentation → Evaluation

Participants will get a limited amount of time to transform their ideas into functional prototypes and pitch their solutions to the judging panel.

Projects will be evaluated on factors such as:

  • Innovation & Originality
  • Problem Relevance
  • Technical Implementation
  • Creativity & Design
  • Feasibility & Scalability
  • Impact
  • Presentation & Pitch

Ready to test your skills?

Bring your ideas, laptop, skills, creativity and a lot of enthusiasm.

The mountains may be high, but the possibilities are higher.

Build something. Break boundaries.

prizes.others: Originality, creativity, uniqueness of the solution, and innovative use of technology.
Code quality, technical complexity, system architecture, integration, and working prototype
Potential to solve a real-world problem, societal benefit, inclusivity, and measurable impact.
Usability, interface design, accessibility, user journey, and overall experience.
Scalability, sustainability, commercial or adoption potential, and a realistic roadmap for future development.
prizes.rank: Best Emerging Idea & Future Potential Award
